description: Image Description: The image features a striking sculpture situated on a sandy beach under a clear blue sky. The sculpture consists of a tall, white surfboard adorned with large, stylized blue flowers, which are painted or affixed to its surface. Leaning against the surfboard is a human-like figure, entirely coated in a glossy, reflective blue material that gives it a metallic or chrome-like appearance. The figure is posed with one hand raised to its head, as if shielding its eyes from the sun
